about: Made-up multiple-choice questions in voice mode's six languages (English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Italian) for the reading aloud (rounds' services/voice_clips.py speak): each is turned into what the interviewer reads by rounds' own question_script (text, a code block pointed to the screen, the select-all note, options with letters A-D), read by the speech model, heard by the transcription model and compared with the script by code: word error rate, every option's letter heard, and nothing added (an answer, a comment). Technical terms and abbreviations (B-tree, JSON, HTTP 404, OAuth, p95, CI/CD, GDPR), numbers, and traps that tempt an answer (questions put to the listener, 'which is correct?', an instruction inside the text). Hand-written.
